title: Jason Arday’s death is institutional murder
english: Jason Arday, a history-making Black professor at the University of Cambridge, passed away shortly after resigning from his position following a relentless public campaign against him. Critics from across the political spectrum targeted him with accusations of plagiarism and personal ridicule, which many argue were rooted in systemic racism and opposition to diversity initiatives. Despite investigations finding no evidence of academic misconduct, the intense media scrutiny and harassment he faced have been described as a form of institutional cruelty.

title: US-Iran Memorandum of Understanding expires: How and why it fell apart
english: A peace agreement signed by the United States and Iran in June has expired without achieving its goals. Although the deal was intended to stop military actions and facilitate negotiations, ongoing conflicts, disagreements over shipping rights, and continued hostilities in the region caused it to collapse. Despite the mediation efforts, the broader war remains unresolved as both nations continue to trade attacks.

title: Arsenal preview: Key questions heading into 2026-27 Premier League season
english: Arsenal enters the 2026-27 season as the reigning Premier League champions, aiming to secure back-to-back titles for the first time in nearly a century. The team has bolstered its roster with new signings like Bruno Guimaraes, though they face a significant challenge due to William Saliba’s long-term injury. After narrowly missing out on the Champions League title last year, the club is highly motivated to finally claim Europe's top trophy.

title: Trump orders US to scale back South Korea military drills
english: President Trump has directed the United States military to reduce the scope of joint training exercises with South Korea. He justified this decision by highlighting his positive rapport with the North Korean leader and noting South Korea's choice not to participate in the conflict involving the U.S. and Iran. Experts suggest this move might be a strategic attempt by the administration to assign responsibility for ongoing war challenges elsewhere.

title: Trump says US could bomb Oman if it ‘gets in the way’
english: Donald Trump has issued a warning to Oman, stating the U.S. could take military action against the nation if it interferes with Washington's peace objectives regarding Iran. This threat surfaced as Oman and Iran negotiate a joint maritime agreement concerning the Strait of Hormuz. The situation highlights ongoing tensions as both countries work to finalize their strategic transit plans in the region.

title: Trump contradicts Vance on top US goal in Iran war
english: President Donald Trump has identified preventing Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons as the administration's primary objective. This stance appears to clash with Vice President JD Vance, who previously stated that prioritizing affordable fuel prices for Americans was the administration's main focus. Trump emphasized that stopping Iran's nuclear ambitions remains his top priority, overriding the economic concerns mentioned by his vice president.

title: Iran warns enemies to 'anticipate strategic surprises' as it shifts from a defensive stance
english: A senior official from Iran's Revolutionary Guard announced a shift in military strategy from defense to offense, warning adversaries to expect unexpected actions. This change comes alongside a notable decrease in maritime traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, Iran is negotiating with Oman to establish a secure transit route while criticizing the US for allegedly violating a previous diplomatic memorandum.

title: US considering nuclear weapons against Iran as war falters, claims Marjorie Taylor Greene
english: Former congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene has alleged that the Trump administration is actively considering the use of nuclear weapons against Iran due to ongoing military challenges. Greene, a former ally of the president, claims this potential escalation is dangerous and contradicts earlier intelligence assessments regarding Iran's nuclear capabilities. Meanwhile, reports suggest the US military is facing significant shortages in missile stockpiles, leading the Pentagon to explore the role of tactical nuclear weapons in regional conflicts.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት የኮንግረስ አባል ማርጆሪ ቴይለር ግሪን፣ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በኢራን ላይ እየገጠመው ባለው ወታደራዊ ችግር ምክንያት የኒውክሌር መሳሪያዎችን ለመጠቀም እያሰበ ነው የሚል ውንጀላ አቅርበዋል። የቀድሞው የፕሬዚዳንቱ አጋር የሆኑት ግሪን፣ ይህ እርምጃ አደገኛ መሆኑን እና ከኢራን የኒውክሌር አቅም ጋር በተያያዘ ቀደም ብለው ከነበሩ መረጃዎች ጋር እንደሚጋጭ ይናገራሉ። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ የአሜሪካ ጦር በሚሳኤል እጥረት እየተቸገረ በመሆኑ የፔንታጎን ባለስልጣናት በክልላዊ ግጭቶች ውስጥ የኒውክሌር መሳሪያዎችን ሚና ለመገምገም እየሞከሩ እንደሆነ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Miseensi koooree duraanii Maarjoorii Teyiler Giiriin akka himatetti, mootummaan Doonald Traamp waraana Iiraan irratti taasisaniin dhibbaa waan mudateef, meeshaalee niwukilaraa fayyadamuuf yaadaa jira. Giiriin, gorsituu kanaan dura Traamp biratti fudhatama qabdu turte, tarkaanfii akkasii kun balaa guddaa qabaachuu fi odeeffannoo Iiraan irratti dura qabamee ture waliin kan wal-faallessu ta'uu ibsiteetti. Gama biraatiin, waraanichi meeshaalee waraanaa hedduu waan fixee jiruuf, Pentagoniin waraana naannichaa keessatti meeshaalee niwukilaraa fayyadamuu irratti mari'achaa jiraachuu gabaasni ni mul'isa.

title: Is the world experiencing more earthquakes now than before?
english: Despite recent high-profile earthquakes, global seismic activity remains within normal statistical ranges compared to the last decade. While many earthquakes occur annually, the severity of a disaster depends more on a quake's depth and proximity to populated areas than its magnitude. Scientists confirm that there is no evidence of an increase in earthquake frequency, and major seismic events remain impossible to predict.
amharic: በቅርብ ጊዜ የታዩትን የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦች ብንመለከትም፣ ዓለም አቀፋዊው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ መጠን ባለፉት አስር ዓመታት ከነበረው መደበኛ ሁኔታ ጋር የሚመጣጠን ነው። የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ የሚያስከትለው ጉዳት በዋናነት የሚወሰነው በመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ ጥልቀት እና በከተሞች ቅርበት ላይ እንጂ መጠኑ ላይ ብቻ አይደለም። ሳይንቲስቶች የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ድግግሞሽ መጨመሩን የሚያሳይ ማስረጃ እንደሌለ እና ትላልቅ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦችን አስቀድሞ መተንበይ እንደማይቻል ያረጋግጣሉ።
oromo: Garee dhihoo kana keessa sochiin lafaa mul'ate iyyuu, haalli sochiin lafaa addunyaa gara waggaa kudhan darbe keessatti ture waliin wal fakkaata. Miidhaan sochiin lafaa fidu kan murtaa'u guddina isaa qofa irratti utuu hin taane, gadi fageenya lafaa fi bakka magaalaatti dhihoo ta'uu isaa irratti hundaa'a. Saayintistoonni sochiin lafaa dabaluu isaa kan agarsiisu ragaan akka hin jirre fi balaa akkanaa dursanii beekuun akka hin danda'amne mirkaneessaniiru.

title: USS Lincoln crisis: How it compares to past aircraft carrier deployments
english: The USS Abraham Lincoln has been on an extended deployment in the Middle East for nearly nine months, leading to severe mental health struggles and poor living conditions for its 5,000 crew members. Families report that exhausted sailors are facing food shortages and unsanitary facilities due to a lack of port stops. While US military leaders maintain that the blockade operations are essential, the situation has sparked significant concern from lawmakers regarding the well-being of the personnel on board.
amharic: የዩኤስኤስ አብርሃም ሊንከን የጦር መርከብ ለአምስት ሺህ ሠራተኞቹ አስቸጋሪ በሆነ ሁኔታ ለዘጠኝ ወራት ያህል በቅርብ ምስራቅ ተሰማርቶ በመቆየቱ በሠራተኞቹ የአእምሮ ጤና ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። የመርከቧ ሠራተኞች ምግብ እጥረት እና ንፅህና የጎደላቸው የመኖሪያ ሁኔታዎች እያጋጠሟቸው መሆኑን ቤተሰቦቻቸው ገልጸዋል። የዩኤስ የጦር መሪዎች የዘመቻውን አስፈላጊነት ቢናገሩም፣ በሠራተኞቹ ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው ጉዳት በሕግ አውጪዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Markabni waraanaa USS Abraham Lincoln ji'oota sagaliif gidduu galaa bahaatti turuun isaa hojjattoota shan kuma ta'an irratti miidhaa sammuu fi haala jireenyaa badaa fideera. Maatiin akka ibsanitti, hojjattoonni dadhabuu, nyaata dhabuu fi bakka qulqullina hin qabne keessa jiraachuu irraa kan ka'e rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru. Hoggantoonni waraanaa Ameerikaa hojiin kun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsanus, haalli kun miseensota mana maree biyyattii biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Iraqi Kurdish PM Barzani’s office targeted in drone attack
english: The office of the Prime Minister of Iraq's Kurdistan region and the home of a top security official were recently targeted by drone strikes launched from Iran. Fortunately, no injuries occurred during these attacks. Prime Minister Masrour Barzani condemned the incident as a major security threat and an unacceptable act.
amharic: የኢራቅ የኩርዲስታን ክልል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጽህፈት ቤት እና የከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ሃላፊ መኖሪያ ቤት ከኢራን በተነሱ ድሮኖች ጥቃት ደርሶባቸዋል። እንደ እድል ሆኖ በጥቃቱ የሰው ህይወት አልጠፋም። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር መስሩር ባርዛኒ ይህንን ድርጊት ለክልሉ ሰላም እና መረጋጋት ስጋት የሆነ ተቀባይነት የሌለው ተግባር በማለት ኮንነውታል።
oromo: Waajjirri Ministira Muummee naannoo Kurdistaan kan Iraaq fi mana jireenyaa hogganaa nageenyaa ol'aanaa irratti haleellaan xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) Iraan irraa ka'een raawwatameera. Gammachuu haa ta'u malee, haleellaa kanaan miidhaan lubbuu tokko illee hin geenye. Ministirri Muummee Masruur Baarzaanii gochicha balaaleffatanii, kun tasgabbii naannichaa irratti balaa cimaa fi kan hin fudhatamne ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Indian temple stampede kills seven people and injures dozens
english: A tragic stampede at a Hindu temple in India's Bihar state resulted in the deaths of seven people during the holy month of Shravan. Additionally, nearly twenty other individuals sustained injuries as large crowds gathered for the religious event. This incident marks the second time this year that a deadly crush has occurred at an Indian place of worship.
amharic: በህንድ ቢሃር ግዛት በሚገኝ የሂንዱ ቤተ መቅደስ በተፈጠረ የሰዎች መጨናነቅ ሰባት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በሹራቫን ቅዱስ ወር በቤተ መቅደሱ በተሰበሰቡ ምዕመናን መካከል በተፈጠረው አደጋ ከአስራ ዘጠኝ በላይ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ አደጋ በዘንድሮው ዓመት በህንድ ቤተ መቅደስ ሲከሰት ሁለተኛው ነው።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti bakka waaqeffannaa Hinduu tokko keessatti namoonni torba walitti heddummachuun miidhaa mudateen lubbuun darbeera. Ayyaana Shraavan ilaalchisee namoonni hedduun walitti qabamanii turan keessatti namoonni 19 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Mudannoon kun bara kana keessatti bakka waaqeffannaa Indiyaa keessatti yeroo lammaffaadhaaf kan mudatedha.

title: Is China encroaching upon Indian territory in Arunachal Pradesh?
english: A report from an Indian political coalition alleges that Chinese forces have restricted the Indian military's access to certain patrol areas within the Arunachal Pradesh region. This finding has caused significant political friction in New Delhi, putting pressure on the government to address the ongoing border tensions. The situation complicates diplomatic relations between the two nations ahead of an upcoming BRICS summit hosted by India.
amharic: የህንድ የፖለቲካ ጥምረት ባወጣው ዘገባ መሰረት የቻይና ኃይሎች በअरናቻል ፕራዴሽ ግዛት የህንድ ወታደሮች ወደተወሰኑ የጥበቃ ቦታዎች እንዳይገቡ ከልክለዋል። ይህ ግኝት በኒው ዴልሂ የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ የፈጠረ ሲሆን መንግስት በድንበር ላይ ስላለው የቻይና እንቅስቃሴ ምላሽ እንዲሰጥ ጫና ፈጥሯል። ይህ ክስተት በህንድ አስተናጋጅነት በሚካሄደው የብሪክስ ጉባኤ ዋዜማ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Indiyaa fi gareen siyaasaa isaa tokko akka jedhanitti, humni Chaayinaa naannoo Arunaachal Piraadesh keessatti loltoonni Indiyaa bakka tokko tokko akka hin qaqqabne dhorkaa jira. Gabaasni kun magaala guddoo Niiw Deelhii keessatti mormii siyaasaa kan uume yoo ta'u, mootummaan waa'ee daangaa kanaa irratti ibsa akka kennu dhiibbaan irratti godhamaa jira. Haalli kun walgahii BRICS kan Indiyaan qopheessituuf jirtuun dura walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii akkasumas tasgabbii naannichaa irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jira.

title: Watch: Young chef, 16, cooking up gourmet meals in Gaza
english: Despite losing his father and home during the ongoing conflict in Gaza, 16-year-old Yasser Ayad continues to pursue his passion for cooking. Living in a tent with limited resources, he creates traditional Palestinian meals using aid rations and shares them on social media. His efforts have turned him into a well-known figure, helping to preserve his family's culinary legacy during a time of immense hardship.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት አባቱን እና ቤቱን ያጣው የ16 ዓመቱ ያሰር አያድ፣ የማብሰል ፍላጎቱን በጽናት በመቀጠል ላይ ይገኛል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በድንኳን ውስጥ የሚኖረው ወጣቱ፣ እጅግ በተገደበ የምግብ አቅርቦት እንኳን ባህላዊ የፍልስጤም ምግቦችን በማዘጋጀት በሶሻል ሚዲያ ያጋራል። ይህ ተግባሩም በአስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ሆኖ የቤተሰቡን የምግብ አሰራር ባህል ለማስቀጠል የሚያደርገው ጥረት በመሆኑ ብዙዎችን ትኩረት ስቧል።
oromo: Waraana Gaaza keessatti abbaa isaa fi manasaa kan dhabe dargaggeessi waggaa 16 Yasser Ayad, jaalala isaa kan nyaata affeeluu cimsatee itti fufee jira. Yeroo ammaatti dunkaana keessa kan jiraatu ta'us, nyaata gargaarsaan argamu fayyadamuun nyaata aadaa Falasxeen qopheessuudhaan miidiyaa hawaasaarratti qooda. Carraaqqiin isaa kun haala ulfaataa keessattillee aadaa maatii isaa eeggachuuf kan isa dandeessise ta'uun namoota baay'ee biratti beekamtii argateera.

title: Iran says Hormuz transit route deal reached with Oman
english: Iran and Oman have reached a preliminary agreement regarding shipping transit routes through the Strait of Hormuz. Under this plan, vessels would pass through the strait along specific paths near the two countries without incurring any interim fees. Both nations are currently finalizing the official details of this arrangement to be released in a joint statement.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ የንግድ መርከቦች ጉዞ ላይ ስምምነት ላይ መድረሳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። በዚህ እቅድ መሰረት መርከቦች ክፍያ ሳይከፍሉ በሁለቱ ሀገራት አቅራቢያ በተወሰኑ መስመሮች በኩል ማለፍ ይችላሉ። ሁለቱ ሀገራት የዚህን ስምምነት ዝርዝር ሁኔታ በማጠናቀቅ ላይ ሲሆኑ በቅርቡም በጋራ መግለጫ ይፋ እንደሚያደርጉት ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Iraanii fi Omaaniin karaa dooniin galaana Hormuz ittiin darban irratti walii galtee irra ga'aniiru. Karoora kanaan, dooniiwwan kaffaltii tokko malee karaa adda ta'een biyyoota lamaan gidduu darbuu danda'u. Biyyoonni lamaan kun dhimma kana irratti gadi fageenyaan mari'achaa jiran yoo ta'u, dhiyootti ibsa waloo baasuuf qophaa'aa jiru.

title: Thousands await aid after deadly Indonesia quake as rescue work conducted
english: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake in Indonesia's East Nusa Tenggara province has resulted in at least 68 deaths and over 200 injuries. Thousands of people have been displaced as over 1,300 homes and various public buildings were damaged or destroyed. Local authorities have declared a 14-day state of emergency while rescue teams continue to search for survivors amidst the urgent need for humanitarian aid.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዥያ ምስራቅ ኑሳ ተንጋራ ግዛት የተከሰተው የ7.7 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 68 ሰዎችን ሲገድል ከ200 በላይ የሚሆኑትን አቁስሏል። ከ1,300 በላይ የመኖሪያ ቤቶች እና በርካታ የህዝብ ተቋማት በመውደማቸው በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች መፈናቀላቸውን ተከትሎ የአካባቢው አስተዳደር የ14 ቀናት የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ አውጇል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በፈራረሱ ህንጻዎች ስር የተጠመዱ ሰዎችን ፍለጋ ቀጥለዋል፣ የተጎዱት ሰዎችም አስቸኳይ የሰብአዊ ድጋፍ እየጠበቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Indoneziyaatti bakka 'East Nusa Tenggara' jedhamutti lafti socho'uun isaa hanga ammaatti lubbuu namoota 68 kan galaafate yoo ta'u, namoonni 200 ol ta'an immoo miidhamaniiru. Manneen jireenyaa 1,300 ol ta'anifi bu'uraalee misoomaa hedduu waan diigamaniif namoonni kumaatamaan qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru. Bulchiinsi naannichaa guyyoota 14f kan turu labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa kan labse yoo ta'u, ogeeyyonni gargaarsaa namoota diigama jala jiran barbaaduu itti fufanii jiru.

title: Iraqi Kurdistan leader says Iranian drones targeted his office
english: Masrour Barzani, the Prime Minister of Iraq's Kurdistan region, reported that Iranian drones recently attacked his office and the residence of a top security official. He condemned these strikes as an unacceptable and dangerous move that threatens regional stability. These attacks are part of a growing pattern of drone and missile strikes affecting the area during the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: የኢራቅ ኩርዲስታን ክልል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር መስሩር ባርዛኒ፣ የኢራን ድሮኖች የእሳቸውን ቢሮ እና የከፍተኛ ደህንነት ባለስልጣን መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ ጥቃት እንደሰነዘሩ ገልጸዋል። ይህንን ድርጊት የክልሉን ደህንነት እና መረጋጋት አደጋ ላይ የሚጥል አደገኛ እና ተቀባይነት የሌለው ጥቃት ሲሉ ኮንነዋል። በአካባቢው እየተካሄደ ባለው ውጥረት ምክንያት የዚህ አይነት የድሮን እና ሚሳኤል ጥቃቶች በክልሉ ላይ በተደጋጋሚ ሲፈጸሙ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Muummichi Ministiraa naannoo Kurdistaan kan Iraaq Masruur Baarzaanii, xiyyooronni (dron) Iraan ofiisii isaa fi mana jireenyaa qondaala nageenyaa olaanaa tokko irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Hojiin kun nageenyaa fi tasgabbii naannichaa kan miidhuu fi gonkumaa kan hin fudhatamne ta'uu isaa ibsaniiru. Haleellaan kun waldhabiinsa naannichatti jiru wajjin walqabatee, yeroo dhihoo asitti haleellaawwan xiyyooraa fi miseelii naannichatti baay'ataa dhufan keessaa tokko dha.

title: Kushner to meet Netanyahu after talks with Hamas leaders
english: US envoy Jared Kushner has held discussions with Hamas leaders in Egypt regarding a potential peace proposal for Gaza. Following these talks, he is scheduled to meet with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to address the ongoing conflict. While Hamas has shown interest in the plan, Israel maintains that any long-term agreement must include the complete disarmament of the group.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በጋዛ ሰላም እቅድ ላይ ለመወያየት በግብፅ ከሀማስ መሪዎች ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። ከዚህ ውይይት በኋላ ከእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ጋር እንደሚመክሩ ይጠበቃል። ሀማስ ለዕቅዱ ፍላጎት ቢያሳይም፣ እስራኤል ግን ማንኛውም ስምምነት የሀማስን ትጥቅ መፍታት ማካተት እንዳለበት አጥብቃ ትጠይቃለች።
oromo: Ergamtooni Amerikaa Jaared Kushner karoora nagaa Gaazaarratti mari'achuuf Gibxii keessatti hogganoota Hamaas waliin wal arganiiru. Marii kana booda, dhimma kana irratti muummicha ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu waliin kan mari'atan ta'a. Hamaas karoora kanaaf fedhii kan agarsiise ta'us, Israa'el garuu waliigalteen kamiyyuu hidhannoo hiikkachuu Hamaas kan of keessatti qabatu ta'uu qaba jettee amanti.

title: Burnham apologised for Gaza. He has 100 days to prove he meant it
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham recently apologized for his party’s past handling of the Gaza conflict, acknowledging that their previous stance caused significant distress. However, critics argue that words alone are insufficient and that he must now take concrete actions to regain public trust. Over the next 100 days, his political future will likely depend on how he addresses key issues like settlement trade and arms exports to Israel.
amharic: የብሪታንያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የጋዛን ግጭት አስመልክቶ ፓርቲያቸው ቀደም ሲል የወሰደው አቋም ከፍተኛ ቅሬታ መፍጠሩን በመቀበል ይቅርታ ጠይቀዋል። ይሁን እንጂ፣ የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት፣ ይቅርታው ብቻውን በቂ ስላልሆነ መሪው ህዝባዊ አመኔታን ለመመለስ ተግባራዊ ለውጦችን ማሳየት ይጠበቅባቸዋል። በቀጣዮቹ 100 ቀናት ውስጥ የኢስራኤል የሰፈራ ንግድን መከልከልን ጨምሮ በሚወስዷቸው ወሳኝ እርምጃዎች የወደፊት የፖለቲካ ዕጣ ፈንታቸው ይወሰናል።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa Biriitaaniyaa Andy Burnham walitti bu'iinsa Gaazaa ilaalchisee dhaabbanni isaanii kanaan dura qabatee ture miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa amanuun dhiifama gaafataniiru. Haa ta'u malee, qeeqonni akka jedhanitti, jechi qofti gahaa waan hin taaneef amantii ummataa deeffachuuf tarkaanfii qabatamaa fudhachuu qabu. Guyyoota 100 itti aanan keessatti, dhimmoota ijoo akka daldala buufataalee fi meeshaalee waraanaa Israa'eliif erguu ilaalchisee murtoo isaan dabarsan eegumsa siyaasaa isaanii kan murteessu ta'a.

title: Inside the UK’s ‘stressful’ cost of living crisis Burnham hopes to tackle
english: Many families in the United Kingdom are struggling to afford essential needs due to a severe and persistent cost of living crisis. Individuals like Donna O'Hara, who faces personal health challenges and financial hardship, are increasingly forced to rely on food banks and face the threat of eviction. The new government has pledged to address these economic pressures to help those currently unable to cover their basic expenses.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም እየተባባሰ የመጣው የኑሮ ውድነት ብዙ ቤተሰቦች መሰረታዊ ፍላጎቶቻቸውን ማሟላት እንዳይችሉ አድርጓቸዋል። እንደ ዶና ኦሃራ ያሉ በጤና እክልና በኢኮኖሚ ችግር ውስጥ የሚገኙ ዜጎች የምግብ እርዳታ ላይ ለመውደቅና ከመኖሪያ ቤታቸው የመፈናቀል ስጋት ተጋርጦባቸዋል። አዲሱ የሀገሪቱ መንግስት ይህንን አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ለመቅረፍና ለተጎጂዎች እፎይታ ለመስጠት ቃል ገብቷል።
oromo: Biyyoota tokko tokko keessatti gatiin jireenyaa waan dabaleef maatiin baay'een wantoota barbaachisoo ta'an bitachuu irratti rakkataniiru. Namoonni akka Donna O’Hara dhibee fayyaafi rakkoo dinagdee keessa jiran gargaarsa nyaataa barbaaduufi mana isaanii keessa ari'amuu sodaachuun dirqamaniiru. Mootummaan biyyattii haaraan rakkoo diinagdee kana furuufi namoota gargaarsa barbaadan cinaa dhaabbachuuf waadaa galeera.

title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
english: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake in Indonesia's Flores island has resulted in at least 53 deaths and displaced 5,000 people. Many survivors are sleeping outside due to constant aftershocks, while damaged infrastructure and landslides are preventing critical aid from reaching those in need. There is growing concern regarding food and water shortages as hospitals struggle to operate in temporary tents.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ ፍሎሬስ ደሴት የተከሰተው የ7.7 ማግኒቱድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 53 ሰዎችን ሲገድል 5,000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን አፈናቅሏል። ተጎጂዎች ከቀጣይ የድህረ-መሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በመስጋት ከቤት ውጭ በመተኛት ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ የመንገድ መዘጋት እና የመሰረተ ልማት ውድመት አስቸኳይ እርዳታ ወደ ስፍራው እንዳይደርስ እንቅፋት ሆኗል። በዚህም ምክንያት የምግብ እና የንፁህ ውሃ አቅርቦት እጥረት ስጋት እያደገ መጥቷል።
oromo: ጉንጉን 7.7 kan ta'e biyya Indoneezhiyaa magaalaa Flores keessatti kan mudate yoo ta'u, lubbuun namoota 53 yoo darbu, namoonni 5,000 ol ta'an immoo buqqa'aniiru. Namoonni miidhaan irra ga'e dachii irratti guyyaa fi halkan kan bulan yoo ta'u, sababa kosiin biyyee cufameef gargaarsi hatattamaa bakka barbaachisu gahuun rakkisaa ta'eera. Haala kanaan, rakkoon nyaataa fi bishaanii hammaachaa waan jiruuf, dhaabbileen fayyaa bakka buufata yerootti fayyadamuun tajaajila kennuuf yaalaa jiru.

title: Will India’s ‘Cockroach’ movement force Modi’s BJP to rethink its politics?
english: India's ruling BJP party is facing a significant political shift following a surprising election loss in Bihar and widespread youth-led protests. The protest movement, humorously named the 'Cockroach Janta Party,' emerged after insensitive remarks by officials regarding unemployed youth and successfully pressured the Education Minister to resign. As the BJP struggles to maintain its traditional dominance, it is now attempting to adapt its strategies to better engage with India's disillusioned Gen Z population.
amharic: የህንድ ገዢው የቢጄፒ ፓርቲ በቢሃር ግዛት ባጋጠመው አስደንጋጭ የምርጫ ሽንፈት እና በወጣቶች በሚመራው ሰፊ ተቃውሞ ምክንያት ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ፈተና ገጥሞታል። 'ኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ' በመባል የሚታወቀው የተቃውሞ እንቅስቃሴ የተፈጠረው በስራ አጥ ወጣቶች ላይ በተሰነዘረ ንቀት የተነሳ ሲሆን፣ እንቅስቃሴው የትምህርት ሚኒስትሩ በስልጣን እንዲለቁ ማስገደድ ችሏል። የቢጄፒ ፓርቲ የነበረውን የበላይነት ለማስጠበቅ እየተቸገረ ሲሆን፣ አሁን ግን ተስፋ የቆረጡ የህንድ ወጣቶችን ለመሳብ ስልቶቹን ለመቀየር እየሞከረ ነው።
oromo: Paartiin biyya bulchu Hindii BJP, injifannoo ajaa'ibaa naannoo Bihaaritti isa mudate fi hiriira dargaggootaa bal'aa booda rakkoo siyaasaa keessa galeera. Sochiin 'Cockroach Janta Party' jedhamu kun, dargaggoota hojii dhabeeyyii irratti ibsa tuffii of keessaa qabu kennamuu hordofee kan uumame yoo ta'u, ministeera barnootaa aangoo gadi akka lakkisu dirqisiiseera. Paartiin BJP humna siyaasaa isaa duraanii itti fufsiisuuf qabsaa'aa jiraachuun, amma dargaggoota biyyattii gama siyaasaatiin abdii kutatan harkisuuf mala isaa jijjiirrachaa jira.

title: Photos: Rising energy prices disrupt education on Cambodia’s Tonle Sap lake
english: Soaring fuel costs caused by global geopolitical conflicts are forcing families living on Cambodia's Tonle Sap lake to prioritize survival over schooling. As transportation becomes more expensive, children are frequently skipping classes to help their parents earn extra income through manual labor. International aid organizations warn that this economic pressure is causing a widespread rise in child poverty and school dropouts across Asia and Africa.
amharic: በአለም አቀፍ ግጭቶች ምክንያት እየጨመረ የመጣው የነዳጅ ዋጋ በካምቦዲያ ቶንሌ ሳፕ ሐይቅ አካባቢ የሚኖሩ ቤተሰቦች ከትምህርት ይልቅ መትረፍን እንዲቀድሙ እያስገደዳቸው ነው። የመጓጓዣ ዋጋ መጨመር ተማሪዎች ቤተሰቦቻቸውን ለመርዳት ትምህርታቸውን እንዲያቆርጡ እያደረጋቸው ይገኛል። ዓለም አቀፍ የዕርዳታ ድርጅቶች ይህ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ በእስያ እና በአፍሪካ የሕፃናት ድህነትን እና ትምህርት ማቋረጥን በስፋት እየጨመረ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Gatiin boba'aa dhiibbaa waldhabdee addunyaatiin ol ka'e, maatiiwwan haroo Tonle Sap Kamboodiyaa jiraatan barnoota irra jiraachuu akka dursan isaan dirqisiiseera. Gatiin geejjibaa dabaluun isaa ijoolleen maatii isaanii gargaaruuf jecha barnoota akka irraa hafan taasisaa jira. Dhaabbileen gargaarsa addunyaa dhiibbaan diinagdee kun guddina hiyyummaa ijoollee fi barnoota dhaabuu biyyoota Eshiyaa fi Afriikaa keessatti akka babal'ate akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Scottie Scheffler wins St Jude Championship by eight shots
english: World number one Scottie Scheffler secured a dominant victory at the St Jude Championship in Memphis, winning by an impressive eight strokes. This performance earned the American golfer his 21st PGA Tour title and a prize of $3.6 million. By winning this opening event of the FedEx Cup playoffs, he has significantly strengthened his position heading into the next tournament.
amharic: የዓለማችን ቁጥር አንድ ጎልፍ ተጫዋች ስኮቲ ሼፍለር በሜምፊስ በተካሄደው የሴንት ጁድ ሻምፒዮና በስምንት ምቶች ልዩነት በማሸነፍ አስደናቂ ድል አስመዝግቧል። አሜሪካዊው ተጫዋች በዚህ ድል የ21ኛው የፒጂኤ ቱር ዋንጫ ባለቤት ከመሆኑም በላይ 3.6 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የገንዘብ ሽልማት አግኝቷል። ይህ የፌዴክስ ካፕ የጥሎ ማለፍ ውድድር መክፈቻ ድል ወደ ቀጣዩ ውድድር ሲያቀና የአቋሙን ጥንካሬ በእጅጉ ከፍ አድርጎለታል።
oromo: Taphataan golaafii addunyaa sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti argamu Iskoottii Shefeler, dorgommii St Jude Championship magaalaa Memfisiitti gaggeeffameerratti injifannoo guddaa galmeesseera. Iskoottii morkattoota isaa immoo iskoorii sagaliin dursuun injifannoo kana kan argate yoo ta'u, waancaa PGA Tour 21ffaa isaa fi badhaasa maallaqaa miiliyoona 3.6 fudhateera. Injifannoon inni dorgommii Fedex Cup irratti argate kun, dorgommii itti aanuuf qophii gaarii akka ta'uuf isa gargaareera.

title: US senator condemns Ben Gvir’s call to 'kill 30 or 40 people in Gaza every night'
english: US Senator Jacky Rosen has demanded the resignation of Israeli Minister Itamar Ben Gvir following his controversial suggestion that Israeli forces should kill dozens of Gazans daily. Senator Rosen labeled these remarks as unacceptable and urged Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to officially disavow the statement. She emphasized that individuals promoting violence against civilians are unfit to serve in government roles.
amharic: የአሜሪካዋ ሴናተር ጃኪ ሮዘን የእስራኤሉ ብሔራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር በየዕለቱ በጋዛ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን መግደል ያስፈልጋል በሚል የሰጡትን አስተያየት ተከትሎ ከስልጣናቸው እንዲለቁ ጠይቀዋል። ሴናተሯ አስተያየቱን አሰቃቂ እና ተቀባይነት የሌለው በማለት የገለፁት ሲሆን፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁም ንግግሩን እንዲያወግዙ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በንፁሃን ላይ ጥቃትን የሚያበረታታ ማንኛውም ሰው በመንግስት ስልጣን ላይ ሊኖር አይገባም ሲሉም አስምረውበታል።
oromo: Senaterri Ameerikaa Jaakii Roosen, ministirri nageenya biyyaa Israa'el Itaamaar Ben Gvir guyyaa guyyaan namoota hedduu Gaazaatti ajjeechuun barbaachisaadha jechuun yaada kennan booda akka aangoo gadhiisan gaafataniiru. Senaterittin yaada kana kan balaaleffatan yoo ta'u, Muummichi Ministiraa Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuun yaada kana akka ifatti balaaleffatan gaafataniiru. Namni kamiyyuu siviliidha irratti haleellaa raawwachuu kan jajjabeessu taanaan aangoo mootummaa irra turuun isa itti gaafatamummaa kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Cincinnati Open: Sabalenka takes six match points to defeat Gibson
english: World number one Aryna Sabalenka advanced to the third round of the Cincinnati Open after a challenging victory against Talia Gibson. Although Sabalenka dominated the first set, she needed six match points to finally secure the win during a difficult second-set tiebreaker. Other top players, including Elena Rybakina and Mirra Andreeva, also successfully progressed to the next stage of the tournament.
amharic: የዓለም ቁጥር አንድ ተጫዋች አሪና ሳባሌንካ በሲንሲናቲ ኦፕን የቴኒስ ውድድር ታሊያ ጊብሰንን በማሸነፍ ወደ ሶስተኛው ዙር አልፋለች። ሳባሌንካ የመጀመሪያውን ዙር በቀላሉ ብትቆጣጠርም፣ ሁለተኛውን ዙር ለማሸነፍ ግን ስድስት ጊዜ የጨዋታ ነጥቦችን መጠቀም አስፈልጓታል። እንደ ኤሌና ሪባኪና እና ሚራ አንድሬቫ ያሉ ሌሎች ከፍተኛ ተጫዋቾችም ወደ ቀጣዩ የውድድሩ ምዕራፍ ማለፍ ችለዋል።
oromo: Taphattuun sadarkaa tokkoffaa addunyaa Aryna Sabalenka dorgommii Cincinnati Open irratti Talia Gibson injifachuun gara sadarkaa sadaffaatti darbiteetti. Sabalenka setii jalqabaa salphaatti injifatteus, setii lammaffaa irratti injifannoo argachuuf carraa dha'ichaa ja'a fayyadamtee jirti. Akkasumas, taphattoonni gurguddoon akka Elena Rybakina fi Mirra Andreeva dorgommicharratti injifannoo argachuun gara sadarkaa itti aanuutti darbanii jiru.

title: Outrage as Colombia’s president hands out footballs as residents await aid
english: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella is facing significant public criticism after distributing footballs to people in a city recently struck by an earthquake. Residents expressed frustration as the gesture occurred while they are still waiting for critical humanitarian aid. Many have condemned the move, viewing the provision of sports equipment as insensitive given the urgent need for basic relief supplies.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያው ፕሬዚዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪዬላ በመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በተመታ ከተማ ለተጎጂዎች የእግር ኳስ ኳሶችን በማደላቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት ገጥሟቸዋል። ነዋሪዎቹ አሁንም አስቸኳይ ሰብአዊ እርዳታ እየጠበቁ ባሉበት ወቅት ይህ ድርጊት መፈጸሙ ቅሬታ አስነስቷል። ብዙዎች መሰረታዊ እርዳታ በሚያስፈልግበት ወቅት እንዲህ አይነት ስጦታ መስጠትን እንደ ግድየለሽነት በመቁጠር ኮንነውታል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Kolombiyaa Abelardo de la Espriella magaalaa kirkira lafaatiin miidhamte keessatti kubbaa miillaa raabsuun isaanii komii guddaa kaaseera. Jiraattonni deeggarsa namoomaa ariifachiisaa eeggachaa jiran kanatti, gochi kun kan hin mallee fi gaddi kan itti dhaga'ame ta'uu ibsaniiru. Namoonni hedduun haala rakkisaa keessa jirannitti deeggarsa bu'uuraa dhabanii osoo jiran, kennaan akkanaa kun xiyyeeffannoo kan hin qabne akka ta'eitti mormaniiru.

title: Kushner to meet Netanyahu to push Trump Gaza plan
english: Jared Kushner is meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to advocate for a Gaza peace plan that the Israeli government has previously opposed. This follows Kushner's recent discussions in Egypt with Hamas leadership and international mediators to establish specific steps for the plan's implementation. While the proposed roadmap includes a gradual disarmament of Hamas and the withdrawal of Israeli forces, Netanyahu remains resistant to these terms ahead of the upcoming Israeli elections.
amharic: ጃሬድ ኩሽነር የእስራኤል መንግስት ውድቅ ያደረገውን የጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅድ ለማራመድ ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ጋር እየተወያዩ ነው። ይህ ውይይት የተካሄደው ኩሽነር በግብፅ ከሃማስ አመራሮች እና ከአለም አቀፍ አማላጆች ጋር ዕቅዱን ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ ከታቀዱ እርምጃዎች ጋር በተያያዘ ከተነጋገሩ በኋላ ነው። የቀረበው የሰላም ካርታ የሃማስን ትጥቅ መፍታት እና የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከጋዛ መውጣትን የሚያካትት ቢሆንም፣ ኔታንያሁ ግን ይህንን ዕቅድ መቀበል አልፈለጉም።
oromo: Jaared Kushner karoora nagaa Gaaza kan mootummaan Israa'el duraan didde san dhiibbaa gochuuf ministira mummee Benyaamin Netanyaahuu waliin mari'achaa jira. Mariin kun kan ta'e erga Kushner Gibxii keessatti hogganoota Hamaasii fi giddu-galeeyyii idil-addunyaa waliin tarkaanfiiwwan karoora kana raawwachiisanirratti mari'atanii booda. Kaartaan nagaa dhihaate kun meeshaa hiikkannaa Hamaasii fi ba'iinsa waraana Israa'el kan dabalatu ta'us, Netanyaahuu filannoo dhufuuf qophaa'aa jiran kanaaf jecha karoora kana fudhachuu didaa jiru.

title: At least six people killed in Ukrainian missile attack on Russia’s Belgorod
english: A Ukrainian missile strike on the Russian border region of Belgorod has resulted in at least six deaths and several injuries. Simultaneously, Russian forces conducted widespread drone and missile assaults across various parts of Ukraine, killing four people and wounding many others. These back-and-forth attacks highlight an escalation in violence that is causing the highest civilian casualty rates since the early stages of the conflict.
amharic: በሩሲያ የቤልጎሮድ ክልል በዩክሬን በተሰነዘረ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ ስድስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በዩክሬን የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ባደረሱት ድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት አራት ሰዎች ተገድለው ብዙዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ የተባባሰ ጥቃት ከጦርነቱ መጀመሪያ ወራት በኋላ ከፍተኛው የሲቪል ህዝብ ሞት ያስከተለ ሆኗል።
oromo: Humni Yukreen naannoo Belgorod kan Raashiyaa irratti miisaayilii erguun namoota jaha ajjeesee kanneen biroo hedduu maysiseera. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, Raashiyaan guutuu Yukreen keessatti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) fi miisaayiliin geggeessiteen namoonni afur du'anii kaan madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan walirraa hin cinne kun erga waraanichi eegalee as, lammiilee nagaa irratti miidhaa hamaa gahuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Iran says talks with Oman continue on new Hormuz transit route
english: Iran and Oman are currently negotiating the creation of a secure shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz to facilitate safer commercial travel. An Iranian official noted that the process has been slow due to regional security tensions involving the United States and Israel. This initiative aims to protect the sovereign interests of both nations while ensuring vessels can pass through the area without interference.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር በኩል ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ የንግድ መርከቦች ማለፊያ መስመር ለመዘርጋት ንግግር እያደረጉ ነው። የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር እንዳስታወቀው፣ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ሳቢያ በተፈጠረው የፀጥታ ችግር ምክንያት የድርድሩ ሂደት ረጅም ጊዜ ወስዷል። ይህ ዕቅድ የሁለቱን ሀገራት ሉዓላዊነት በማስጠበቅ የንግድ መርከቦች ያለምንም ስጋት እንዲያልፉ ለማስቻል ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Iiraan fi Omaan karaa galaana Hormuz keessaatti qaxxaamura nagaa ta’e uumuuf marii taasisaa jiru. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iiraan akka ibsetti, sochii waraanaa Ameerikaa fi Israa’el irraa kan ka’e rakkooleen nageenyaa waan jiraniif mariin kun yeroo dheeraa fudhachaa jira. Karoorri kun mirgaa fi fayyadamummaa biyyoota lamaanii eeguu fi malkaa’inaan markaboonni daldalaa akka darban taasisuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Iran says 60-day deadline under US deal is no longer relevant
english: Iran has announced that a 60-day timeframe tied to a recent agreement with the U.S. is now meaningless. The Iranian government claims that Washington violated the deal shortly after it was made, preventing scheduled talks on sanctions and nuclear issues from starting. Consequently, officials in Tehran stated they will not operate under external deadlines or ultimatums.
amharic: ኢራን ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ጋር በተደረገው ስምምነት ላይ የተቀመጠው የ60 ቀናት የጊዜ ገደብ ከአሁን በኋላ ዋጋ እንደሌለው አስታውቃለች። የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር እንዳለው፣ አሜሪካ ስምምነቱን በመጣሷ በኒውክሌር እና በኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ላይ ሊደረጉ የነበሩ ድርድሮች ሳይጀምሩ ቀርተዋል። በመሆኑም፣ ኢራን በውጫዊ ግፊት ወይም በጊዜ ገደብ መመራት እንደማትፈልግ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Iraan waliigaltee Ameerikaa waliin godhatte keessatti guyyaan 60 inni darbe amma gatii akka hin qabne ibsiteetti. Mootummaan Iraan akka jedhutti, Ameerikaan waliigaltee sana erga mallatteessite booda waan cabsiteef, mariin dhimma niwukilaraa fi sanqishinii irratti godhamuuf karoorfame hin eegalle. Kanaafuu, Iraan dhiibbaa ykn yeroo daangeffame jalatti hojjechuu akka hin barbaanne ibsiteerti.

title: Morning update
english: Jared Kushner held high-level discussions in Egypt regarding the Gaza conflict while shipping through the Strait of Hormuz dropped significantly following recent attacks. Meanwhile, Iran threatened an offensive shift in its military strategy, and Israeli forces are preparing for a potential escalation in Lebanon. Additionally, Yemen's government reported launching military strikes against Houthi positions in the al-Jawf region.
amharic: ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በጋዛ ግጭት ዙሪያ በግብፅ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ያላቸው ውይይቶችን አድርገዋል። በሌላ በኩል በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት የመርከብ እንቅስቃሴ በእጅጉ ቀንሷል። ኢራን ወደ ጥቃት አዘል ወታደራዊ ስትራቴጂ እንደምትቀየር ስታስጠነቅቅ፣ የእስራኤል ጦርም በሊባኖስ ሊባባስ የሚችል ግጭት ለማስተናገድ እየተዘጋጀ ነው። በተጨማሪም የየመን መንግስት በሁቲዎች ላይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ማድረሱን አስታውቋል።

Gama biraatiin, haleellaa daandii galaana Hormuz irratti raawwatameen wal qabatee, sochii dooniiwwanii gadi bu’eera. Iraan tarsiimoo waraanaa ishee gara haleellaatti akka geeddartu akeekkachiisaa jirti; waraanni Israa’el immoo walitti bu’iinsa Libaanoos keessatti uumamu danda’uuf qophiirra jira. Kana malees, mootummaan Yemen bakkeewwan Huutonnii itti argaman irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Rodri headed to Barcelona after Man City accepts transfer bid
english: Manchester City has agreed to sell midfielder Rodri to Barcelona for approximately 88 million dollars. The Spanish star, who won numerous trophies during his seven seasons in England, has signed a four-year contract with the Catalan club. He is expected to finalize the move next week after deciding not to extend his tenure at the Etihad Stadium.
amharic: ማንቸስተር ሲቲ አማካዩን ሮድሪን በ88 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ግምታዊ ዋጋ ለባርሴሎና ለመሸጥ ተስማምቷል። በኢንግላንድ በቆየባቸው ሰባት ዓመታት በርካታ ዋንጫዎችን ያነሳው ስፔናዊው ኮከብ፣ ከባርሴሎና ጋር የአራት ዓመት ኮንትራት ተፈራርሟል። ተጫዋቹ በማንቸስተር ሲቲ ያለውን ውል ላለማራዘም በመወሰኑ፣ በቀጣዩ ሳምንት ዝውውሩን ሙሉ ለሙሉ ያጠናቅቃል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Maanchistar Siitiin sarara gidduu taphataa Roodrii tilmaamaan doolara miiliyoona 88n gara Baarseloonaatti gurguruuf waliigaleera. Taphatichi biyya Ispeen kan waggoota torba Ingilizitti darbaniif badhaasaa hedduu injifate, garee Baarseloonaa waliin kontiraata waggaa afurii mallatteesseera. Taphatichi Maanchistar Siitii waliin qabu dheeressuu waan dideef, torban dhufu kanatti jijjiirraa isaa xumuruuf deemudha.

title: Record rains drench South Korean city as landslide kills one
english: Heavy rainfall in the South Korean city of Geoje has led to a deadly landslide that buried an apartment building and killed one person. The area experienced record-breaking downpours that submerged streets and forced the suspension of public services and transportation. This incident is part of a series of intense storms affecting various parts of Asia, driven by climate conditions linked to El Niño.
amharic: በደቡብ ኮሪያ ጂዮጄ ከተማ በጣለ ከፍተኛ ዝናብ ምክንያት በተከሰተ የመሬት መንሸራተት የአንድ ሰው ህይወት አልፏል። ከተማዋ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ የዝናብ መጠን በመጥለቅለቋ የመንገድ ትራንስፖርት እና የህዝብ አገልግሎቶች እንዲቋረጡ ተደርጓል። ይህ አደጋ በኤል ኒኖ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ምክንያት በእስያ ሀገራት እየተከሰተ ካለው ተከታታይ እና ከባድ አውሎ ንፋስ አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Magaalaa Jiyojee kan biyya Kooriyaa Kibbatti rooba cimaa robeen hordofee lafti sigigee namni tokko lubbuun isaa darbeera. Roobni seenaa keessatti galmaa'e kun magaalattii keessatti guuracha uumee, tajaajiloota ummataa fi geejjiba addaan kutuun dirqama ta'eera. Balaan kun jijjiirama qilleensaa El Niinoo jedhamuun walqabatee biyyoota Eshiyaa keessatti roobni cimaan kun hordofee mudataa jiru keessaa isa tokko.

title: Japan’s economy slows, missing growth forecasts
english: Japan's economy grew by only 0.3 percent in the second quarter, falling short of analysts' expectations due to weak consumer spending and lower business investments. While exports remained strong, high energy costs and a weakened currency are putting significant pressure on the country's financial outlook. This sluggish performance may create challenges for the Bank of Japan as it considers further changes to its interest rate policies.
amharic: የጃፓን ኢኮኖሚ በሁለተኛው ሩብ ዓመት በ0.3 በመቶ ብቻ በማደጉ የትንታኔ ባለሙያዎችን ግምት ሊያሟላ አልቻለም። የሸማቾች ወጪ መቀነስ እና አነስተኛ የንግድ ኢንቨስትመንቶች ለዚህ ዕድገት መቀዛቀዝ ዋና ምክንያቶች ሆነዋል። ከፍተኛ የኃይል ዋጋ እና የየን ምንዛሬ ዋጋ ማሽቆልቆል በሀገሪቱ የፋይናንስ ሁኔታ ላይ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ሲሆን፣ ይህም የጃፓን ማዕከላዊ ባንክ የወለድ ምጣኔ ውሳኔዎችን አስቸጋሪ ሊያደርግብት ይችላል።
oromo: Diinagdeen Japanii kurmaana lammaffaa keessa dhibbeentaa 0.3 qofa guddatee, eeggumsa ogeeyyii dinagdee bira gahuu dadhabeera. Hir'inni fayyadama qabeenyaa fi invastimantiin daldalaa gadi bu'uun isaa guddina kana irratti dhiibbaa uumeera. Gatiin anniisaa ol ka'uu fi gadi bu'uun gatii maallaqa biyyattii (Yen) dinagdee Japanii irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeef, baankii giddu galeessaatiif murtiiwwan dhala maallaqaa irratti jijjiirama gochuun rakkisaa ta'uu danda'a.

title: Cameroon dominates Malawi to win first Women’s Africa Cup of Nations title
english: Cameroon secured their first-ever Women's Africa Cup of Nations title after a decisive 3-0 victory against Malawi in Morocco. Marie Ngah scored twice and Naomi Eto added another goal to dominate the match by halftime. Both finalists have successfully qualified for the upcoming Women's World Cup in Brazil.
amharic: ካሜሩን ሞሮኮ ውስጥ በተካሄደው የሴቶች የአፍሪካ ዋንጫ ፍጻሜ ማላዊን 3 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ ታሪካዊ ድል ተቀዳጅታለች። ማሪ ንጋህ ሁለት ግቦችን ሲያስቆጥሩ፣ ናኦሚ ኢቶ ተጨማሪ ግብ በማከል ቡድኑ በጨዋታው የበላይነቱን እንዲወስድ አድርገዋል። ሁለቱም አገራት ለቀጣዩ የሴቶች የዓለም ዋንጫ ማለፋቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Kaameeruniin tapha xumuraa Waancaa Afrikaa kan dubartootaa irratti Maalaawwii 3-0 injifachuun seenaa keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf mo'atteetti. Maarii Ngaah goolii lama lakkoofsisuun akkasumas Naa'omii Eetoo goolii tokko galchuun gareen kun harka caaluun akka injifatu taasiseera. Gareewwan lamaanuu gartuu xumuraa ga'uun isaanii Waancaa Addunyaa dubartootaa kan bara dhufu Biraaziilitti gaggeeffamuuf akka darban mirkaneessaniiru.

title: At least seven dead in ‘stampede-like’ incident at India temple
english: At least seven people were killed and over a dozen injured during a chaotic incident at the Ashok Dham temple in India's Bihar state. Authorities report that the tragedy began when an electric pole fell and caused electrocutions, triggering a stampede among a large crowd of worshippers. Local officials are investigating the event, while the state government has pledged support for the victims and their families.
amharic: በህንድ ቢሃር ግዛት በሚገኝ የአሾክ ዳም ቤተ መቅደስ በተፈጠረ የሰው መረማመስ ቢያንስ ሰባት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ከአስር በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለፁት፣ ክስተቱ የኤሌክትሪክ ምሰሶ በመውደቁ ምክንያት በተፈጠረ የኤሌክትሪክ ንዝረት እና በቀጠለው የህዝብ ግፊት የተከሰተ ነው። የክልሉ መንግስት ለተጎጂዎች አስፈላጊውን ህክምና እንደሚያደርግ እና ጉዳዩን እያጣራ መሆኑን አስታውቋል።

Bulchiinsi naannichaa miidhamtootaaf gargaarsa barbaachisaa ta'e gochuuf waadaa galee, sababa balaa kanaa ilaalchisee qorannoo eegaleera.

title: Iranian official says Israel setting 'nightly quota' for killing Palestinians in Gaza
english: Iranian official Kazem Gharibabadi has condemned Israel, claiming that Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has established a daily target for killings in Gaza. He criticized Israel for simultaneously planning the expulsion of Palestinians and the building of settlements in the territory. Gharibabadi stated that these actions must be documented to ensure future legal accountability for those responsible.

oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran Kazem Gharibabadi, Israa'el gaaza keessatti guyyaa guyyaan namoota ajjeesuuf qooda baasuu ishee himachuun balaaleffataniiru. Itti gaafatamaan kun, Israa'el gama tokkoon namoota biyyattiirraa ariitee, gama biraatiin immoo naannichatti iddoo qubannaa ijaaruuf karoorfachuu ishee ibsaniiru. Gochoota kunneen gara fuulduraatti seera duratti dhiyaachuuf akka ragaatti qabamuu qabanis eeraniiru.

title: Yemeni government claims attacks on Houthis
english: The internationally recognized Yemeni government reported conducting a series of military strikes against Houthi forces across multiple regions. These operations, which included artillery fire and drone attacks, were aimed at Houthi strongholds in al-Jawf and Marib. Officials stated that these weekend maneuvers resulted in dozens of casualties among Houthi fighters.
amharic: የየመን ዓለም አቀፍ እውቅና ያገኘው መንግስት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ተከታታይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶችን መፈጸሙን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ በከባድ መሳሪያ እና በድሮን የታገዙ ጥቃቶች በአል-ጀውፍ እና በማሪብ ግዛቶች የሚገኙ የሁቲዎችን መሸሸጊያዎች ኢላማ ያደረጉ ናቸው። መንግስት ባለፈው ሳምንት መጨረሻ በተካሄዱት 181 ኦፕሬሽኖች በርካታ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መገደላቸውንና መቁሰላቸውን ገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen kan addunyaan beekamtii kenneef, haleellaa waraanaa garee Huutii irratti gaggeessuu isaa beeksisera. Haleellaan kun kan of keessatti qabatu dhukaasa meeshaa gurguddaa fi xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) fayyadamuudhaan naannolee al-Jawf fi Marib keessatti iddoowwan Huutiin itti gargar bahaa turan kan xiyyeeffate ture. Mootummaan akka ibsetti, duula waraanaa torbee dhumaa keessa gaggeeffame kanaan miseensonni garee Huutii hedduun ajjeefamuu fi madaa'uu isaanii ibseera.

title: Ukrainian strikes kill six in Russia, acting governor says
english: Ukrainian missile attacks on the Belgorod region of Russia have resulted in six deaths and several injuries, including a child. These strikes occurred near the border and caused damage to local property. This incident follows a recent surge in military activity, with both Russia and Ukraine accusing one another of targeting civilian areas.

oromo: Humni Yukreen naannoo Belgorod kan Rashiya irratti miisaayilii ergeen namoonni ja’a ajjeefamanii kan biroon immoo miidhamaniiru. Miidhamtoota kana keessaa daa’imni tokko kan jiru yoo ta’u, qabeenyarrattis miidhaan ga’eera. Walitti bu’iinsi kun erga Rashiyaafi Yukreen wal himachaa turanii booda kan dhalate yoo ta’u, gama lamaanuu namoota nagaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun wal himataa jiru.

title: Iran’s top negotiator declares victory in war against the US and Israel
english: Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Iran’s parliament speaker and lead negotiator, has publicly claimed that his country has achieved both military and political success against the United States and Israel. This statement coincides with the expiration date of a temporary 60-day agreement between Iran and the US. These remarks reflect ongoing tensions as the deadline for the diplomatic pact passes.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ እና ዋና ተደራዳሪ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ፣ ሀገራቸው በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል ላይ ወታደራዊ እና ፖለቲካዊ ድል ተቀዳጅታለች ሲሉ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ መግለጫ በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል የነበረው የ60 ቀናት ጊዜያዊ ስምምነት መጠናቀቂያ ቀን ላይ የተሰጠ ነው። መግለጫው የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ስምምነቱ ማብቂያ ጊዜ እየደረሰ ባለበት ወቅት የተፈጠረውን ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantuu fi mari'achiisaa olaanaa paarlaamaa Iraan kan ta'an Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, biyyi isaanii Ameerikaa fi Israa'el irratti injifannoo waraanaa fi siyaasaa argachuu ishee beeksisaniiru. Ibsi kun kan kenname yeroo waliigaltee guyyaa 60f Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti ture xumuramuutti yoo ta'u, kunis walitti dhufeenya yeroo ammaa jiru irratti dhiibbaa uumuu mala.

title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
english: The Democratic Republic of Congo is facing its deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, with the death toll surpassing 2,300 victims. The virus is spreading at an alarming rate across six provinces, complicated by regional conflict and high population movement. While researchers are working on new vaccines for this specific strain, health authorities are struggling to curb the rapid transmission of the disease.
amharic: የኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እስካሁን ካየቻቸው ሁሉ የከፋውን የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ እያስተናገደች ሲሆን የሟቾች ቁጥርም ከ2,300 በላይ ሆኗል። ቫይረሱ በስድስት አውራጃዎች በፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ ሲሆን የአካባቢው ግጭትና የህዝብ እንቅስቃሴ ቁጥጥሩን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። ተመራማሪዎች ለዚህ የኢቦላ ዝርያ ክትባቶችን ለማዘጋጀት እየሞከሩ ቢሆንም፣ የጤና ባለሙያዎች የበሽታውን ስርጭት ለመግታት ከፍተኛ ትግል እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokraatawaa Koongoo keessatti dhibeen Ebola hanga ammaatti mudatee beekamu keessaa isa hamaa ta’ee fi namoota 2,300 ol galaafate mudachuu isaa gabaafameera. Vaayirasichi naannolee jahan keessatti saffisaan kan babal’achaa jiru yoo ta’u, waraanaa fi sochiin ummataa to’achuuf rakkoo ta’ee jira. Qorattoonni vaayirasicha ittisuuf qoricha (vaaksinii) haaraa qopheessaa kan jiran ta’us, ogeeyyonni fayyaa babal’ina dhibee kanaa dhaabuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: Lawyer says Israel’s targeting of Palestinian women is a form of genocide
english: Palestinian lawyer Ahmad Ibsais contends that the ongoing Israeli military actions in Gaza, which have resulted in the deaths of thousands of women and children, constitute a form of genocide. He argues that the specific targeting of Palestinian women is a critical issue that international legal frameworks have failed to adequately address. Since the conflict began in October 2023, the death toll in the region has surpassed 73,000 individuals.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ጠበቃ አህመድ ኢብሳይስ በእስራኤል እየተካሄደ ያለው ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሴቶችና ህጻናትን በመግደሉ ይህ ድርጊት የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል አካል ነው ብለዋል። ጠበቃው አክለውም ዓለም አቀፍ ህግ የፍልስጤም ሴቶችን ኢላማ ያደረገውን ጥቃት ችላ ማለቱን ተችተዋል። ከጥቅምት 2016 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ በተቀሰቀሰው ጦርነት እስካሁን ከ73,000 በላይ ሰዎች መሞታቸው ታውቋል።
oromo: Ogeessi seeraa Falasxiin Ahmad Ibsais akka jedhutti, tarkaanfiin waraana Israa'el Gaazaatti fudhachaa jirtu, kan dubartootaafi ijoollee kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman galaafate, akka sanyi-dhumaatti ilaalama. Inni akka jedhutti, qaamoleen idil-addunyaa miidhaa dubartoota Falasxiin irra gahaa jiru kana xiyyeeffannoo gahaa kennuufii dhabaniiru. Waraanni Adoolessa 2023 eegale kun hanga ammaatti lubbuu namoota 73,000 ol ta'ee galaafateera.

title: Actress Hayden Panettiere dies aged 36, US media report
english: American actress Hayden Panettiere has passed away at the age of 36, according to statements from her family. Known for her performances in popular television shows like Heroes and Nashville, she began her acting career as a young child. Her family has requested privacy while they mourn this unexpected loss, and the specific cause of her death remains undisclosed.
amharic: አሜሪካዊቷ ተዋናይት ሃይደን ፓኔቲየር በ36 ዓመቷ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት መለየቷን ቤተሰቦቿ አስታውቀዋል። እንደ ሄሮውስ እና ናሽቪል ባሉ ተወዳጅ የቴሌቪዥን ድራማዎች የምትታወቀው ሃይደን፣ የትወና ስራዋን የጀመረችው ገና በልጅነቷ ነበር። ቤተሰቦቿ በዚህ አሳዛኝ ሁኔታ ውስጥ የግል መጠጊያ እንዲሰጣቸው የጠየቁ ሲሆን፣ የአሟሟቷ ምክንያት እስካሁን በይፋ አልታወቀም።
oromo: Aartistiin Ameerikaa Hayden Panettiere umurii ishee waggaa 36tti du’aan boqochuun maatiin ishee ibsaniiru. Taphoota televijiinii beekamoo akka ‘Heroes’ fi ‘Nashville’ irratti kan hirmaatte Hayden, hojii ishee kan jalqabde yeroo ijoollummaa isheetti ture. Maatiin ishee gadda kana keessatti kabajaafi nagaa akka isaaniif kennamu gaafatanis, sababa du’a ishee ilaalchisee hamma ammaatti ifa kan hin taaneedha.

title: Thieves steal Renaissance artworks in museum heist during Italian holiday
english: Thieves stole four valuable Renaissance paintings by Antonello da Messina from the MuMe museum in Sicily while the city was busy celebrating a major holiday. The burglars broke through the museum's perimeter and display cases, taking pieces worth millions of euros, though they left two panels behind. Authorities are investigating the heist, which took place while security forces were distracted by large public festivities.
amharic: በሲሲሊ በበዓል አከባበር ወቅት ሌቦች በአንቶኔሎ ዳ መሲና የተሳሉ አራት ውድ የህዳሴ ዘመን ሥዕሎችን ከሙሜ ሙዚየም ሰርቀዋል። ወንጀለኞቹ የሙዚየሙን አጥር እና የመስታወት ሳጥኖች ሰብረው በመግባት በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠር ዩሮ የሚያወጡ ቅርሶችን የወሰዱ ሲሆን፣ ሁለቱን ስዕሎች ግን ትተዋቸዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ የፖሊስ ትኩረት በሕዝባዊ በዓል ላይ በነበረበት ወቅት የተፈጸመውን ይህን ዘረፋ እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hattootni fakkiiwwan warraaqsa Aartii (Renaissance) kan Antonello da Messina, kan gatiin isaanii miliyoonaan kaffalu, buufata Siisilii keessatti argamu irraa hataniiru. Hattootni kun guyyaa ayyaana guddaa magaalaan kun kabajamaa jirtu fayyadamanii, mana kuusaa sana keessatti namoonni yeroo ayyaana irratti xiyyeeffatanitti seentanii hatan. Hattootni kun fakkiiwwan muraasa fudhatanii kanneen biroo bakka sana dhiisanii kan deeman yoo ta'u, qorannoon yakka kanaa itti fufee jira.

title: Ongoing Israeli attacks across southern Lebanon, two injured in Bint Jbeil
english: Israeli military forces have launched a series of airstrikes and artillery attacks across various locations in southern Lebanon. A drone strike on a home in the Bint Jbeil district resulted in injuries to two civilians and caused significant property damage. These ongoing military operations have affected several towns, including al-Qantara, Khiam, and al-Mansouri.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች የአየር እና የመድፍ ጥቃቶችን አድርሰዋል። በቢንት ጅቤል አውራጃ ውስጥ በአንድ መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ በደረሰ የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሲቪሎች ላይ ጉዳት የደረሰ ሲሆን ቤቱም ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አስተናግዷል። እነዚህ የጦር እንቅስቃሴዎች አል-ቃንታራን፣ ኪያምን እና አል-ማንሱሪን ጨምሮ በበርካታ ከተሞች ላይ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el kutaa kibba Libaanoos keessatti bakkeewwan garaagaraatti haleellaa qilleensaa fi meeshaa waraanaan raawwatanii jiru. Godina Bint Jbeil keessatti manaa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara nama malee (drone) gaggeeffameen namoonni nagaa lama madaa'aniiru, akkasumas qabeenyi miidhameera. Hojiiwwan waraanaa kun al-Qantara, Khiam fi al-Mansouri dabalatee magaalota hedduu irratti dhiibbaa geessiseera.

title: US senator slams Trump, Hegseth over 'disgraceful' disregard for American troops
english: Senator Chris Van Hollen has publicly criticized Donald Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth for neglecting the well-being of American soldiers. His remarks follow reports revealing harsh living conditions on U.S. naval ships, such as food shortages and poor sanitation. The senator argued that these leaders are failing to support military personnel and emphasized that ending ongoing conflicts is essential to protect them.
amharic: ሴናተር ክሪስ ቫን ሆለን የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች እየደረሰባቸው ባለው ችግር ዶናልድ ትራምፕን እና የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሰትን በኃላፊነት እንደማይሰማቸው በመግለጽ ተችተዋል። ይህ ትችት የተሰነዘረው በዩኤስ የባህር ኃይል መርከቦች ውስጥ የንጽህና ጉድለት፣ የምግብ እና የውሃ እጥረት እንዲሁም ወታደሮች የከፋ ድካም ውስጥ መሆናቸው ከተሰማ በኋላ ነው። ሴናተሩ ወታደሮቹን ለመጠበቅ አሁን ያለውን ጦርነት ማቆም ወሳኝ እንደሆነ አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Senator Kris Vaan Hollen, Trump fi ministira ittisa biyyaa Piit Hegseth waraana Ameerikaatiif xiyyeeffannoo dhabuusaanii isaanii cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Yaanni kun kan dhufe, dooniiwwan waraana Ameerikaa keessatti hanqina nyaataa, bishaanii fi qulqullinaa akkasumas dadhabbii cimaa waraantotaa ibsuun gabaasamee booda. Senatarichi waraana itti fufaa jiru dhaabuun qofa waraantota keenya fi maatiisaanii eeguuf filannoo gaarii akka ta'e dubbateera.

title: IRGC official warns adversaries to 'anticipate strategic surprises'
english: A high-ranking commander of Iran's Revolutionary Guard has issued a warning to the country's opponents, stating that their military strategy is moving from a defensive to an offensive posture. He emphasized that Iran is fully prepared to counter threats and urged adversaries to be ready for unexpected tactical actions. The official reiterated that any measures needed to protect national security will be implemented whenever the situation demands.
amharic: የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘብ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ አዛዥ አገሪቱ ከመከላከያ ወደ ጥቃት መውጫ ወታደራዊ ስትራቴጂ እየተሸጋገረች መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ጠላቶች ከኢራን ያልተጠበቁ እና ስልታዊ እርምጃዎችን ሊጠብቁ እንደሚገባ አዛዡ አስጠንቅቀዋል። አገሪቱ የደህንነቷን ጉዳይ ለማስከበር እና ማንኛውንም አይነት ስጋት ለመመከት አስፈላጊውን ሁሉ ለማድረግ ዝግጁ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan olaanoo waraana tiksee jijjiiramaa Iraan (IRGC), biyyi isaanii tarsiimoo ittisaa irraa gara tarsiimoo haleellaatti ceʼaa akka jiru akeekkachiisaniiru. Diinonni biyyattii tarkaanfiiwwan abdatamuu hin dandeenye irraa eeggachuu akka qaban ibsaniiru. Biyyattiin nageenya ishee kabajchiisuufi diinota ishee dura dhaabbachuuf murannoo akka qabdu hoggantichi dubbateera.

title: Report: Israeli military prepares for possible escalation in Lebanon
english: The Israeli military is preparing for a potential multi-day escalation of conflict along the Lebanese border. Although government officials have recently avoided some proposed military strikes to keep diplomatic peace talks open, ongoing violence continues to result in significant casualties. The situation remains volatile as military planning proceeds alongside these stalled negotiations.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሊባኖስ ድንበር ላይ ለሚከሰት የበርካታ ቀናት ግጭት ዝግጅት እያደረገ ነው። የሀገሪቱ መንግስት የሰላም ንግግሮችን ላለማስተጓጎል ሲል አንዳንድ የጦርነት ዕቅዶችን የዘገየ ቢሆንም፣ በየቀኑ በሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት እየጠፋ ይገኛል። የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶች ቢኖሩም በሁለቱ አካላት መካከል ያለው ውጥረት አሁንም በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el daangaa Libaanoos irratti walitti bu'iinsa guyyoota hedduuf turuu danda'uuf qophii gochaa jira. Mootummaan Israa'el marii nagaa akka hin miineef tarkaanfii waraanaa tokko tokko kan ittise ta'us, haleellaa ammayyuu itti fufeen lubbuun namoota hedduu darbaa jira. Mariin nagaa utuu jiruu, haalli waraanaa kun ammayyuu sodaachisaa fi kan hin tasgabboofne ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Tehran's foreign ministry slams Canada for backing US war on Iran
english: The Iranian foreign ministry has publicly condemned Canada for its involvement in U.S.-led military actions against Iran. A spokesperson criticized Ottawa for prioritizing American interests despite receiving poor treatment from Washington regarding trade and policy. This statement highlights Iran's view that Canada is merely acting as a subservient partner in conflict rather than an independent actor.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ካናዳ በአሜሪካ የሚመራው በኢራን ላይ የሚደረገውን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በመደገፏ በይፋ ተችቷል። የኢራን ቃል አቀባይ እንዳሉት ካናዳ በንግድ እና በፖሊሲ ረገድ ከአሜሪካ ተገቢ ያልሆነ አያያዝ ቢደርስባትም የአሜሪካን ፍላጎት በማስቀደሟ ተጠያቂ ናት። ይህ መግለጫ ካናዳ በግጭቶች ውስጥ ገለልተኛ አካል ከመሆን ይልቅ የአሜሪካን አጀንዳ እንደምትፈጽም የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri dhimma alaa Iraan, Kanadaa tarkaanfii waraana ykn lola Ameerikaan Iraan irratti geggeessitu keessatti hirmaachuu isheetiif balaaleffateera. Dubbi himaan ministeerichaa, Kanadaan daldalaa fi siyaasa ilaalchisee Ameerikaarraa qormaata hedduu darbuus, fedhii Ameerikaa dursee raawwachuun ishee kan nama gaddisiisuudha jedhan. Haasaa kanaan, Kanadaan lola kana keessatti of danda'ee kan socho'u osoo hin taane, raawwachiiftuu fedhii Ameerikaa taatee akka jirtu ibsameera.

title: Palestinian-American travels to West Bank home encircled by Israeli settler
english: A Palestinian-American named Loui Ridi is traveling from the United States to the West Bank to reach his elderly mother. She is currently trapped alongside 14 other Palestinians in their homes in the village of Qusra. For over a week, these individuals have been surrounded by illegal Israeli settlers, leaving them in a dangerous and isolated situation.
amharic: ሉዊ ሪዲ የተባሉ አሜሪካዊው ፍልስጤማዊ፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚገኘውን የትውልድ መንደራቸውን ለማየት ከአሜሪካ ጉዞ ጀምረዋል። የእሳቸው እናት በኩስራ መንደር ከሌሎች 14 ፍልስጤማውያን ጋር በቤታቸው ተከበው ለአንድ ሳምንት ያህል ተጥለው ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ሰዎች ህገ-ወጥ በሆኑ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች የተከበቡ በመሆናቸው በአደገኛ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Namni Ameerikaa fi Filisxeemii Loui Ridi jedhamu, gara Qixxee gara jiru maatii isaa fi haadha isaa dulloomte bira ga'uuf Ameerikaarraa imala jalqabeera. Haati isaa fi namoonni 14 biroon gandicha keessatti manneen isaanii keessatti qabamanii torban tokkoo ol ta'eera. Namoonni kunneen qubsuma seeraan alaa kan ta'an qubsiistota Israa'elitiin marfamanii haala sodaachisaa keessa jiru.

title: Rare Pallas’s cat captured on camera in northern Iran mountains
english: A rare Pallas’s cat was recently filmed in the remote Nava highlands of northern Iran’s Mazandaran province. This elusive wild feline is seldom seen, making the captured footage a significant discovery for wildlife enthusiasts. Conservationists view this sighting as an important moment for documenting the region's biodiversity.
amharic: በሰሜን ኢራን ማዛንዳራን ግዛት በሚገኙ ተራራማ አካባቢዎች እጅግ ብርቅዬ የሆነው የፓላስ ድመት በካሜራ ተቀረጸ። ይህ አይነቱ የዱር ድመት በቀላሉ የማይታይ በመሆኑ ምስሉ ትልቅ ግኝት ሆኗል። የተፈጥሮ ተመራማሪዎች ይህ ክስተት የአካባቢውን የዱር እንስሳት ሀብት ለመረዳት ወሳኝ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pilaasii (Pallas’s cat) kan jedhamu fi gosa adurree bosonaa baay'ee hin argamne tokko, kaaba Iran naannoo Mazandaranitti viidiyoodhaan qabameera. Adurreen kun argachuun isaa baay'ee kan ulfaatu ta'uu isaa irraa kan ka'e, qabamuu suuraa isaa kana guddina guddaa godheera. Hayyoonni uumamaa, argannoon kun bineensota bosonaa naannichaa keessa jiran qorachuuf gumaacha guddaa akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: Zambia incumbent takes early election lead as opposition alleges armed raid
english: Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema is currently leading the national election with nearly 59 percent of the votes counted, positioning him for a potential first-round win. However, the process has been marred by violence, including the death of a polling agent and serious allegations from the opposition regarding an armed raid on a candidate's home. International observers have also raised concerns about the fairness of the campaign and irregularities during the ballot counting process.
amharic: የዛምቢያው ፕሬዚዳንት ሃካይንዴ ሂቺሌማ በሀገሪቱ እየተካሄደ ባለው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ፣ እስካሁን በተቆጠረው ድምፅ ወደ 59 በመቶ በማግኘት ቀዳሚ ሆነዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የምርጫ ሂደቱ በአመጽ ድርጊቶች እና በተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች በኩል በቀረቡ ከባድ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት ክሶች ታጅቦ ቀጥሏል። አለም አቀፍ ታዛቢዎች የምርጫው አሰጣጥ ፍትሃዊነት እና በድምፅ አቆጣጠር ወቅት የታዩ መቆራረጦች ላይ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii Zaambiyaa Haakaindee Hiichiileemaa sagalee hanga amma lakkaa'ame keessaa dhibbeentaa 59 ol argachuun filannoo biyyattii dursee jira. Ta'us, adeemsi filannichaa jeequmsa fi himannaa diinonni siyaasaa mana isaanii irratti weerarri hidhattootaa raawwatame jedhaniin kan guutame ture. Akkasumas, mormitoonni fi daawwattoonni idil-addunyaa adeemsa filannichaa fi lakkoofsa sagalee irratti rakkoo fi wal-qixxummaa dhabuu jiraachuu isaatiin yaaddoo isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in country’s history
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing its deadliest Ebola outbreak ever, with 2,325 deaths surpassing the previous record set during the 2018-2020 crisis. UN officials are calling for urgent international support, noting that the virus is spreading rapidly due to ongoing conflict and limited medical resources. Because there are no approved vaccines for this specific strain, the death rate has climbed significantly, highlighting a critical need for a faster humanitarian response.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተከሰተ ያለው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ከ2,325 በላይ ሰዎችን በመግደል በሀገሪቱ ታሪክ እጅግ አስከፊው ሆኗል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የጤና ባለሙያዎች ወረርሽኙ በግጭት እና በጤና መሠረተ ልማት እጥረት ምክንያት በፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ መሆኑን በመግለጽ አስቸኳይ ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ ጠይቀዋል። ለዚህ የኢቦላ ዝርያ ተቀባይነት ያለው ክትባት ባለመኖሩ የሟቾች ቁጥር እየጨመረ በመሄዱ ፈጣን የሰብአዊ ድጋፍ መደረግ እንዳለበት ተገልጿል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa keessatti kan hin taane garuu, biyya Koongoo keessatti dhibeen Ebolaa namoota 2,325 ol galaafachuun kisaaraa hamaa seenaa biyyattii keessatti mudate ta'eera. Bakka buutonni Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii dhibeen kun walitti bu'iinsa fi hanqina tajaajila fayyaa irraa kan ka'e ariitiin babal'achaa waan jiruuf deeggarsi idil-addunyaa hatattamaa akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru. Dhibee kanaaf qorichi ykn talaalliin hayyamame waan hin jirreef, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii dabalaa jiraachuun rakkoo guddaa keessa akka galan ifa godheera.

title: Israeli settlers pitch tents for new illegal outpost in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli settlers have set up tents to establish new illegal outposts near Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, further encroaching on Palestinian land. Simultaneously, a group of Palestinian families in the village of Qusra remains under a week-long siege by settlers and soldiers. Additionally, Israeli forces recently raided a home in Beit Imrin, where they arrested several Palestinians and obstructed medical relief efforts.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ራማላ አቅራቢያ አዳዲስ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈሮችን ለመመስረት ድንኳኖችን ተክለዋል። በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ በቁስራ መንደር የሚኖሩ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች ለአንድ ሳምንት ሙሉ በሰፋሪዎች እና በወታደሮች ከበባ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በቤይት ኢምሪን ከተማ በሚገኝ አንድ ቤት ላይ ወረራ በማካሄድ በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር ማዋላቸው እና የህክምና እርዳታ እንዳይደርስ ማገዳቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Baballistoonni Israa'el naannoo Qilleensaa irra jiraattotaa (West Bank) kan ta'e Ramallaah biratti kampiiwwan seeraan alaa dhaabuuf dunkaana dhaaban. Yeroo wal fakkaatuuttis, maatiin warra Filisxeemii baadiyaa Qusraa jiraatan torban tokko guutuu baballistootaa fi waraanaan marfamanii jiru. Kana malees, waraanni Israa'el manaa jireenyaa magaalaa Beit Imrin keessatti argamu weeraruun namoota Filisxeemii hedduu hidhaniiru akkasumas gargaarsi fayyaa akka hin geenye dhorkaniiru.

title: Can the AU make its current Sudan mission count?
english: A delegation from the African Union has arrived in Sudan for a two-day visit aimed at brokering a ceasefire and improving humanitarian aid access. While the Sudanese military has recently reclaimed some territory, the conflict remains deadlocked, making a diplomatic solution difficult to achieve. The AU is working to move beyond just stopping the fighting by encouraging a broader, civilian-led political process to restore long-term stability.
amharic: የአፍሪካ ህብረት ልዑካን ቡድን በሱዳን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ እና የሰብአዊ እርዳታ አቅርቦትን ለማሻሻል የሁለት ቀን ጉብኝት ጀምሯል። የሱዳን ጦር በቅርቡ የተወሰኑ አካባቢዎችን ቢቆጣጠርም፣ በሁለቱ ተፋላሚ ኃይሎች መካከል ያለው የኃይል ሚዛን አሁንም ተቀራራቢ በመሆኑ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄ ለማምጣት አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። ህብረቱ ግጭቱን ከማስቆም ባለፈ፣ ለረጅም ጊዜ የሚቆይ ሰላምን ለማረጋገጥ በሲቪል መሪዎች የሚመራ ሁሉን አቀፍ የፖለቲካ ሂደትን ለመጀመር እየሰራ ነው።
oromo: Ergamtooni Gamtaa Afrikaa waraana Sudaan dhaabsisuufi gargaarsi namoomaa akka ga’u mari’achuuf guyyoota lamaaf biyyattii daawwachuuf dhufaniiru. Waraanni Sudaan naannoolee tokko tokko deebisee to’atus, lolli kun hanga ammaatti furmaata waaraa dhabee jira. Gamtaan Afrikaa waraana dhaabsisuu qofa osoo hin taane, nageenya biyyattii deebisanii dhaabuuf hirmaannaa qaamolee siivilii fayyadamuun furmaata siyaasaa argamsiisuuf yaalii gochaa jira.

title: Trump says US to ‘substantially reduce’ military drills with South Korea
english: President Donald Trump has directed the Pentagon to significantly scale back upcoming joint military drills with South Korea, labeling the exercises as expensive and provocative toward North Korea. Trump cited his positive personal rapport with Kim Jong Un as the primary reason for his dissatisfaction with the long-standing military alliance activities. Despite this directive, South Korean defense officials stated that the planned training exercises will continue as originally scheduled.

title: UN’s Albanese: Israel outsourcing coercion to settlers in West Bank
english: UN official Francesca Albanese has accused Israel of using settlers to intimidate Palestinians in the West Bank. This follows reports that settlers have trapped residents inside their homes in the village of Qusra for an entire week. Albanese emphasized that the Israeli government is ultimately responsible for these acts of coercion carried out by civilian groups.

title: Israeli minister calls for killing ’30 to 40′ Palestinians in Gaza nightly
english: Israel's far-right National Security Minister, Itamar Ben-Gvir, has sparked controversy by calling for the nightly killing of 30 to 40 people in Gaza. During a recent podcast appearance, he expressed extremist views, suggesting that many Palestinians in the region should not be considered human or worthy of life. Although Ben-Gvir lacks the formal authority to direct military actions, his position on the security cabinet allows him to significantly influence Israeli war policies.

title: Jared Kushner lands in Israel after meeting Hamas officials

english: Former U.S. President Donald Trump stated that he reached out to the South Korean leader to see if they would assist in American initiatives to remove nuclear weapons from Iran. english: Violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank has significantly increased under the current far-right government. These frequent attacks have left many Palestinian families confined to their homes and fearful for their safety. Experts are now debating the political motivations behind this rising hostility and the long-term consequences for the region.

oromo: Mootummaa Israa’eel kan harka mirgaa (far-right) ta’een, weerarri goototni Israa’eel (settlers) Baha Baanki keessatti Falasxinoonirratti raawwatan daran dabaleera. Hojiin humnaa kun maatiin Falasxinootaa hedduun mana isaanii keessatti akka cufamanifi sodaa keessa akka jiraatan taasiseera. Ogeeyyiin dhimmi kun maaliif akka dabalaa adeemuufi rakkoolee gara fuulduraa fiduu danda'u irratti mari'achaa jiru.

title: Hundreds of migrants arrested near Ceuta border in latest crackdown
english: Moroccan authorities have detained nearly 300 migrants and 61 suspected smugglers during a recent attempt to reach the Spanish territory of Ceuta. This surge in security follows a massive border crossing two weeks ago that resulted in significant loss of life. Thousands of migrants who successfully entered the enclave are now living in difficult conditions on local beaches while demanding asylum and protesting their potential return to Morocco.
amharic: የሞሮኮ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ ለመግባት ሲሞክሩ የነበሩ ወደ 300 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞችን እና 61 አዘዋዋሪዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ይህ ጥብቅ የጸጥታ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ከሁለት ሳምንት በፊት በድንበር አካባቢ ብዙ ህይወት ያለፈበትን መጠነ ሰፊ የፍልሰት ሙከራ ተከትሎ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት በሴኡታ የሚገኙ እና በችግር ውስጥ የሚኖሩ ስደተኞች፣ ወደ ሞሮኮ ለመመለስ ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆናቸው እና የጥገኝነት መብት እንዲሰጣቸው በመጠየቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Marookoo baqattoota gara naannoo Ispeen Se'uutaatti ce'uuf yaalii godhan guddina 300 gahan fi namoota 61 imala kana mijeessan jedhaman to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga torban lama dura yaalii godaansaa daangaa irratti lubbuun namoota baay'ee darbe booda. Baqattoonni yeroo ammaa Se'uuta keessatti haala ulfaataa keessa jiran, gara Marookootti deebi'uu diduun qulqullina fi mirga kooluu galtummaa akka argatan gaafachaa jiru.

title: Four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings stolen from Italian museum
english: Four highly valuable Renaissance-era paintings created by Antonello da Messina were stolen from a museum in Sicily, Italy, on Saturday night. Authorities are investigating how the thieves bypassed security systems and alarm sensors to remove the items, including one piece taken directly from a display case. Officials suspect the heist may have been a targeted theft intended for the black market.
amharic: አራት እጅግ ውድ የሆኑ የህዳሴ ዘመን የጥበብ ስራዎች በጣሊያን ሲሲሊ በሚገኝ ሙዚየም ውስጥ ቅዳሜ ምሽት ተሰረቁ። አጥፊዎቹ የሙዚየሙን የደህንነት ስርዓት እና ማንቂያ እንዴት እንዳለፉ ባለስልጣናት በምርመራ ላይ ናቸው። ስርቆቱ ጥቁር ገበያ ላይ ለመሸጥ ታቅዶ የተፈጸመ ወንጀል ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተገምቷል።
oromo: Hojiiwwan aartii yeroo Renaissance kan gatiin isaanii guddaa ta'e afur, magaalaa Siisilii, Xaaliyaanii keessatti argamu irraa galgala Sanbata duraa hatamaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa hattoonni kun sirna eegumsaa fi sagalee akeekkachiisaa akkamitti akka darban qorachaa jiru. Hatti kun gabaa gurraachaaf kan qophaa'e ta'uu akka danda'u shakkamaa jira.

title: Anwar Ibrahim: Malaysia between the superpowers
english: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim discussed the challenges smaller nations face amidst the increasing competition between global superpowers. He emphasized the need for middle powers to maintain their sovereignty and promote a rules-based international order even when larger countries ignore established laws. The discussion focused on how nations like Malaysia can protect their own interests while navigating complex trade and political rivalries.
amharic: የማሌዢያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዋር ኢብራሂም በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በታላላቅ ሀገራት መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣው ፉክክር ትናንሽ ሀገራትን ለከፍተኛ ፈተና እየዳረገ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ታላላቅ ሀገራት ዓለም አቀፍ ህጎችን በሚጥሱበት ወቅት መካከለኛ አቅም ያላቸው ሀገራት ሉዓላዊነታቸውን በማስጠበቅ በራሳቸው መንገድ መጓዝ እንዳለባቸው አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። ማሌዢያም ይህን ውስብስብ የፖለቲካ እና የንግድ ፉክክር በመጠቀም የራሷን ጥቅም እንዴት እንደምትጠብቅ በውይይታቸው አንስተዋል።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa Maleeziyaa Anwaar Ibraahiim, dorgommii biyyoota gurguddoo addunyaa gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiruun biyyootni xixiqqoon rakkoo keessa akka jiran ibsaniiru. Biyyootni sadarkaa giddu galeessaa irra jiran, biyyootni gurguddoon seera addunyaa yoo cabsaniyyuu, of danda'anii fi seera kabachiisuudhaan of eeguu akka qaban hubachiisaniiru. Mariin isaanii, biyyootni akka Maleeziyaa daldalaa fi siyaasa addunyaa keessatti faayidaa mataa isaanii akkamitti eeggachuu akka danda'an irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture.

title: Death toll rises to 84 from capsized ferry in Zimbabwe
english: A ferry accident on Lake Kariba has resulted in at least 84 deaths after the overloaded vessel capsized during strong winds. The boat was carrying more people than its official capacity while traveling toward remote fishing communities. President Mnangagwa has acknowledged the tragedy, noting that it highlights severe transportation infrastructure issues in the region.
amharic: ዚምባብዌ ውስጥ ካሪባ ሐይቅ ላይ በተፈጠረ የጀልባ አደጋ ቢያንስ 84 ሰዎች መሞታቸው ተረጋግጧል። ጀልባዋ ከቅቡ አቅሟ በላይ በመጫኗ እና በጠንካራ ንፋስ ምክንያት ነው የገለበጠችው። የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንት ኤመርሰን ምናንጋግዋ አደጋውን አስከፊ ነው ብለው፣ ይህ ክስተት በዘርፉ ያለውን የመሰረተ ልማት ችግር የሚያሳይ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Zimbabwee keessatti markabni haroo Kaaribaa keessatti galgaleeroo sadarkaa lubbuu dabarsuu kanaan namoonni 84 ol du'aniiru. Markabichi namoota baay'ee fe'ee fi bubbee cimaan waan rukutameef gadi garagaleera. Prezidaantiin biyyattii Emmerson Mnangagwa balaa kana balaaleffatanii, balaan kun rakkoo geejjibaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa biyyattii keessatti mul'atu kan agarsiisu ta'uu dubbataniiru.

title: Recap of latest developments in West Bank
english: Tensions rose in the occupied West Bank as Israeli settlers attacked a Palestinian doctor and besieged a home, resulting in the detention of nine residents by Israeli forces. Additionally, military units raided the village of al-Mughayyir, and settlers unsuccessfully attempted to steal horses in Tayasir. These incidents highlight the ongoing instability and violence affecting various Palestinian communities across the region.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በፈጸሙት ጥቃት አንድ የፍልስጤም ዶክተር መቁሰላቸውን እና ዘጠኝ ፍልስጤማውያንን በአንድ ቤት ከበው በኃይላቸው እንዲያዙ ማድረጋቸውን ዘገባዎች አመላክተዋል። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በአል-ሙጋይር መንደር ወረራ ያካሄዱ ሲሆን በታያስር መንደር የሚገኙ የፈረስ ባለቤቶችም የሰፋሪዎች የስርቆት ሙከራ ገጥሟቸዋል። እነዚህ ክስተቶች በአካባቢው እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጸጥታ መደፍረስና ግጭት ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Zoonii Dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti weeraraa fi jeequmsi itti fufee jiraachuu gabaasameera. Gareen Israa'el tokko doktera Falasxiinaa tokko irratti reebicha raawwatanii fi maatii sagal mana tokko keessatti marsanii qabsiisuun humnoota Israa'eliin akka hidhaman taasisaniiru. Kana malees, waraanni Israa'el baadiyaa al-Mughayyir weeraruu fi gochi hattootaa farda horii hatuuf yaalan Taayasiir keessatti mul'ateera. Gochootni kun haala nagaa dhabuu fi walitti bu'iinsa naannichatti babal'achaa jiru kan calaqqisiisani dha.

title: Israelis harass Palestinian-owned cafe in Iceland, tear down Palestine map
english: A group of suspected Israeli tourists recently caused a disturbance at a Palestinian-owned cafe in Iceland. The individuals harassed the establishment's employees and forcibly removed a framed map of Palestine displayed on the wall. The incident was documented by the cafe's surveillance cameras.
amharic: በአይስላንድ በሚገኝ የፍልስጤማውያን ባለቤትነት ስር ባለው ካፌ ውስጥ እስራኤላውያን ተብለው የተጠረጠሩ ግለሰቦች ሁከት ፈጥረዋል። ግለሰቦቹ በካፌው ሰራተኞች ላይ የቃላት ጥቃት ከመሰንዘራቸውም በላይ ግድግዳ ላይ የተሰቀለውን የፍልስጤም ካርታ ቀደዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በካፌው የደህንነት ካሜራዎች ተቀርጿል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa keessatti namoonni Israa'elota jedhamanii shakkaman kafee warra Falasxiin qabani tokko keessatti jeequmsa uumaniiru. Namoonni kun hojjattoota kafee sanaa irratti miidhaa erga geessisanii booda, kaartaa Falasxiin kan keessa turee fi dallaa irratti maxxanfame cicciranii kukkutaniiru. Gochi kunis kaameeraa nageenyaa kafee sanatiin waraabamee jira.

title: Erdogan says Hamas acted sincerely, criticises Israeli attacks
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has publicly expressed support for Hamas, describing their recent actions as sincere. During an interview, he strongly condemned Israel's ongoing military operations in Gaza and Lebanon as aggressive. Furthermore, Erdogan noted that Donald Trump is worried about the regional instability, and he emphasized that Turkey remains committed to preventing the conflict from spreading further.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ታይፕ ኤርዶغان ሀማስ በቅርቡ የወሰዳቸውን እርምጃዎች ቅንነት የተሞላባቸው ናቸው በማለት ድጋፋቸውን ገልጸዋል። በቃለ መጠይቁ ወቅት እስራኤል በጋዛ እና በሊባኖስ እየፈጸመች ያለችውን ወታደራዊ ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። በተጨማሪም ኤርዶغان ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በክልሉ ስላለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ ስጋት እንዳላቸው በመጥቀስ፣ ቱርክ ግጭቱ እንዳይባባስ ጥረቷን እንደምትቀጥል አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Turkii Rajab Tayyib Erdogaan gocha gareen Hamaas raawwate dhugaa fi qulqulluudha jedhanii deggeran. Gargaarsii gaaffii fi deebii isaa irratti, weerara Israa'el Gazaas ta'e Libaanoos irratti gaggeessaa jirtu cimsanii balaaleffatan. Kana malees, Erdogaan Donald Traamp sodaa nageenya naannichaa irratti qaban eeranii, Turkii giddigiddiin kun caalaatti akka hin babal'anne ittisuuf carraaqqii gochuushee itti fuftu ibsan.

title: Trump hails Saudi-Turkiye-Pakistan defence pact
english: Former President Donald Trump publicly praised a new military cooperation agreement signed between Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan. He stated that this 'Mecca Joint Defence Agreement' represents a significant step toward regional stability and self-reliance. Trump congratulated the leaders of these three nations for forming a strategic alliance that he believes will reshape security efforts in the Middle East.

oromo: Pirezidaantii duraanii Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp biyyoota Sa'ud Arabiyaa, Turkii fi Paakistaan gidduutti waliigalteen ittisa biyyaa mallattaa'uu isaa gammachuudhaan ibsaniiru. Waliigalteen 'Makaa Joint Defence Agreement' jedhamu kun tasgabbii naannichaa mirkaneessuufi biyyoonni kunneen of ittisuuf gahee guddaa akka qaban ibsameera. Tiraamp hoogganoonni biyyoota sadanii kun tarkaanfii cimaa fi barbaachisaa ta'e kana fudhachuu isaaniif galata galchaniiru.

title: Iran parliament speaker says US used more firepower in Iran than on Vietnam
english: The Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, claimed that the United States has deployed more military force against Iran than it did during the Vietnam War. He emphasized that Iran needs to strengthen its defensive capabilities to establish deterrence. According to Ghalibaf, this approach is necessary to prevent the country from being caught in a repetitive pattern of conflict and unstable peace.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ መሀመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የተጠቀመችው ወታደራዊ ኃይል ከቬትናም ጦርነት የበለጠ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። ኢራን ከጦርነት እና ከሰላም ዑደት ለመውጣት የሚያስችል ጠንካራ የመከላከያ አቅም መገንባት እንዳለባትም አሳስበዋል። ይህ የጦር መከላከል አቅም ለአገሪቱ ዘላቂ ሰላም ወሳኝ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iran, Mohammad Baager Gaalibaaf, Amerikaan Iran irratti humna waraanaa addunyaa kan Vietnam irra caalu fayyadamteetti jechuun dubbatan. Iran walitti bu'iinsa fi nagaa gidduutti akka hin hafneef, dandeettii of irraa ittisuu cimaa qabaachuu akka qabdu hubachiisaniiru. Gaalibaaf akka jedhanitti, tatarree humna waraanaa kanaa cimsachuun nageenya biyyattii itti fufsiisuuf murteessadha.

title: US admiral praises USS Lincoln crew amid reported mental health concerns
english: US Admiral Brad Cooper visited the USS Abraham Lincoln to commend its crew, despite growing concerns from lawmakers regarding the sailors' mental health during an unusually long deployment. Reports indicated that crew members were struggling with the psychological toll of being at sea for over 250 days without a break, leading to extreme incidents like attempted jumps overboard. While the Admiral acknowledged that long-term naval service is difficult, he insisted that the ship’s mental health statistics are currently among the best in the fleet as preparations are made to replace the vessel.
amharic: የአሜሪካው አድሚራል ብራድ ኩፐር የዩኤስኤስ አብርሃም ሊንከን መርከበኞች ከ250 ቀናት በላይ በባህር ላይ በመቆየታቸው እየደረሰባቸው ያለውን የስነ-ልቦና ጫና ተከትሎ መርከቧን ጎብኝተዋል። ህግ አውጪዎች በመርከቧ ላይ ባለው የሰራተኞች የአእምሮ ጤና መቃወስ እና የመርከበኞች እራሳቸውን የመጣል ሙከራ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸው ነበር። አድሚራሉ መርከበኞቹን ቢያወድሱም፣ በረጅም ጊዜ የባህር ጉዞ ላይ የሚከሰቱ ፈታኝ ሁኔታዎችን አምነዋል። መርከቧን በሌላ መርከብ ለመተካት ዝግጅት እየተደረገ ቢሆንም፣ የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንት ግን የአገልግሎት ጊዜው በቂ እንዳልሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Admiralin US Brad Cooper hoggansa isaa jalatti kan jiru doonii xiyyaaraa USS Abraham Lincoln erga namoonni 250 ol qilleensa baharaa keessa turanii booda dhiphina sammuu irra ga'e hordofuun daawwateera. Miseensonni mana maree biyyattii haala fayyaa sammuu fi yaaliin miseensonni doonichaa of darbuuf godhan isaan yaaddessuu ibsaniiru. Admiralichi hojjettoota doonichaa kan galateeffate yoo ta'u, tajaajilli baharaa keessatti yeroo dheeraa dabarsuu haalaan ulfaataa ta'uu isaa amaneera. Doonii kana kan bakka bu'u dooniin biraa erga qophaa'ee booda, pirezidaantiin biyyattii garuu yeroon doonichaa gahaa akka hin taane ibsaniiru.

title: Brazil: Lula, Bolsonaro return to strongholds to launch runs for president
english: Brazil's presidential candidates, President Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, have officially launched their campaigns in their respective political heartlands. The election race features significant focus on economic nationalism and securing support from women, who make up the majority of the electorate, through promises to address rising gender-based violence. While Lula focuses on protecting national resources, the Bolsonaro camp is highlighting its ability to foster international trade relationships.

oromo: Hirmaattotni filannoo prezidaantummaa biyya Brazil, prezidaant Lula da Silva fi senatar Flavio Bolsonaro, bakka bu'ummaa isaanii jabaa ta'e irraa duula filannoo isaanii jalqabanii jiru. Duulli filannoo kun qabeenya biyyattii qabaachuu fi sagalee dubartoota biyyattii irratti xiyyeeffata, akkasumas roorroo dubartoota irratti raawwatamu dhaabsisuuf waadaa galaniiru. Lula qabeenya biyyattii eeguu irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin gareen Bolsonaro hariiroo daldala biyyoota alaa wajjin jiru cimsuun fedhii isaanii ta'uu ibsanii jiru.

title: US-Iran MoU is set to expire: What to know
english: A peace agreement between the United States and Iran is nearing its expiration date with no clear signs of a renewal. While the deal was intended to stop military conflict and economic disruptions in the Gulf, both nations have accused each other of violating its terms. As the deadline approaches, Iran is exploring alternative maritime arrangements, while the U.S. has signaled a more aggressive stance toward controlling key regional waterways.
